data.name: Ezmeralda
data.gender_notes: Ezmeralda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘esmeralda’, meaning ‘exalted one’ or ‘precious one’. In medieval literature, the name was associated with the character Esmeralda from ‘The Hunchback of Notre Dame’. The name Ezmeralda carries the meaning “Exalted, precious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ezmeralda usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of beauty, grace, and purity.
data.etymology: Ezmeralda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, precious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ezmeralda total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Esmeralda gained significant popularity in European culture through Victor Hugo's novel ‘The Hunchback of Notre Dame’, published in 1831. In the story, Esmeralda is a beautiful and enigmatic gypsy woman who captures the hearts of multiple male characters. She is considered a symbol of grace, freedom, and resistance against discrimination and prejudice. The portrayal of Esmeralda as a strong and independent woman has inspired numerous adaptations and interpretations in various forms of media.
data.spiritual_significance: Esmeralda holds spiritual significance as a representation of divinity and sacredness in one's own self-worth and being. The name Esmeralda denotes the value and preciousness of every individual, encouraging us to acknowledge and embrace our unique qualities and strengths. Additionally, the association of the name with the character in ‘The Hunchback of Notre Dame’ highlights the theme of inner beauty and the importance of recognizing it beyond physical appearance.
